The dropdown is the right control, and **Newest added / Oldest added / Title A–Z** are enough for now. I don’t need “recently read.”

A batch of about 25 feels comfortable, and the remaining count on the Load more button makes the behavior clear. The note preview also feels about right: enough to identify the note without letting it take over the list, with an obvious way to expand it.

I approve these large-library, sorting, date, and long-content decisions. Please summarize the settled scope before implementation begins.
